sections.kicker: Made for the way you work
sections.title: From page context to a portable record.
sections.lede: This engine captures page structure and resources. It does not take pixel screenshots.

items.title: Inspect the input
items.body: Read the page’s declared scripts, styles, images and links. Review the candidates and the generated retrieval plan.

items.title: Organize the case
items.body: Keep a matter together in a named local folder, with its items and timestamps.

items.title: Export and check
items.body: Create a bundle with SHA-256 manifests, a Proof Passport and an offline verifier.
